decision.rationale: All five pre-execution design and scoring findings were closed without provider use or a model-selection claim. The corrected factorial comparison may proceed only after its complete build gate.

findings.title: Factor effects used only one cell of the 2x2 allocation design
findings.resolution: Planner and generator effects are now pooled across both levels of the other factor and bootstrapped at the 300-scenario cluster grain.

findings.title: Free-form generator fields could introduce claims outside canonical evidence
findings.resolution: Models now select only bounded lead-style and learner-prompt enums. Deterministic code renders the complete response and inserts the sole canonical evidence claim and citation.

findings.title: Generator cost and latency were aggregated across allocations
findings.resolution: Every generator call now records an allocation-scoped provider role, preserving exact call, completion, latency, token, and cost attribution.

findings.title: A preferred allocation could remain named after a global hard-gate failure
findings.resolution: Any failed global gate now forces selected_allocation_id to null and produces Refine.

findings.title: Persisted response action and deterministic rendering were not revalidated during scoring
findings.resolution: Scoring now requires exact response/action agreement, policy action, source range, citation, atomic claim, and one of the finite deterministic renderings. It also proves the generator factor cannot change the selected action.

limitations: This audit validates the prospective comparison design, not model quality.

Generator selection measures safe strategy production, reliability, latency, and cost; deterministic rendering intentionally prevents unconstrained prose from becoming an authoritative academic claim.
Synthetic policy utility cannot establish real student learning improvement.
